name: HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease
aliases: Cerebral autosomal recessive arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy

criteria.description: Biallelic pathogenic variants in the HTRA1 gene confirmed by genetic testing
Early-onset subcortical ischemic strokes typically before age 50
Premature baldness or alopecia starting in early adulthood
Chronic low back pain due to spondylosis or spondylolisthesis
Diffuse white matter hyperintensities on brain MRI consistent with small vessel disease

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic HTRA1 pathogenic variants plus clinical features of early-onset ischemic strokes and characteristic MRI findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of cerebral small vessel disease and consideration of family history

searchTerms: early strokes in deep brain areas
young onset small vessel brain strokes
diffuse brain tissue abnormalities on MRI

common.symptomName: Chronic low back pain due to spondylosis
searchTerms: long-term lower back pain from spine wear
chronic lumbar pain due to arthritis
persistent back pain from spinal degeneration
gradual memory loss and thinking decline
worsening mental function leading to dementia

rare.symptomName: Visual disturbances due to ischemic events
searchTerms: vision problems from brain blood flow issues
blurred or lost vision due to strokes

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; no specific biomarkers identified
imaging: MRI showing diffuse leukoencephalopathy with subcortical infarcts
Absence of significant large vessel stenosis on MRA
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in HTRA1 gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Premature alopecia and spondylosis on clinical examination

distinguishingFeatures: NOT associated with alopecia or spondylosis
Presence of angiokeratomas and renal involvement

redFlags: Early-onset ischemic strokes in absence of traditional vascular risk factors
Premature alopecia in young adults with neurological symptoms
Progressive cognitive decline with diffuse leukoencephalopathy on MRI
references: Hara K, et al. Cerebral autosomal recessive arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy (CARASIL): a review. Neuropathology. 2020.
Verdura E, et al. HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease: clinical and genetic characteristics. Neurology. 2015.
Orphanet: HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease. ORPHA:482072.
